findings.body: P1/P6: The H4 verdict correction is the right fix. RFC §H4 falsification says any of {median_val_bpc(MoE) > median_val_bpc(dense_matched), dense byte overhead beyond tolerance, exact tie} refutes H4; comparison.json shows median_val_bpc_moe=4.51023 > median_val_bpc_dense=4.13283 and pareto_verdict=Dense-wins-under-byte-equivalence, so H4 must be Refuted. The prior report emitted H4 Confirmed because emit-report.py hardcoded 'Confirmed' for every hypothesis except H3. The new emit-report.py derives H4 from comparison.json.pareto_verdict and rejects unknown verdicts via EmitError, closing the loophole for future outcomes.

P3: falsification analysis now correctly cites both H3 (per-seed bpc parity) and H4 (Pareto verdict Dense-wins-under-byte-equivalence). The Surprises section still records the MoE lm_loss_raw noise (seed 4=0.396813 → seed 1=9.77902) as follow-up context for bd-2v9r/S8 planning; report_self_hash refresh does not affect that section.

P5/P6: audit-production-runner.py --json still returns needs_changes with the two by-design errors (production runner is in_progress; production-looking artifacts exist while runner owner is unresolved). missing_code_surface_count=0 and production_artifact_count=48 confirm the code and artifacts remain in place; both errors clear on bd-3e10j close and do not falsify this bead's closure claims.

P5/P10: verify-packet.sh also fails on missing bd-2v9r Gemini/Claude review evidence, bd-2v9r/bd-1cdu/bd-1rb unresolved dependencies for bd-2v9r, and the audit's observation that this bd-3e10j-claude.json review record was stale before the current run. Those are downstream/packet-level concerns owned by bd-2v9r closure and by the review runner that must land a fresh bd-3e10j Claude review at HEAD 26e01079 (which this invocation supplies) plus the Gemini counterpart.

P9: bundle size and telemetry surface are unchanged from the prior review — full production bundle ~80MB, single MoE seed run-log ~8.2MB, 20,000 grad-log lines per run, 80,000 router-step telemetry lines per MoE seed (4 layers × 20,000 steps). No new size regression from the HEAD 26e01079 patch, which touches only Markdown/Python/review-record files.

P10: telemetry surface remains complete — grad-log.jsonl carries per-step {global_l2, max_l2, mean_l2} with phase and burn_adamw optimizer_state; router-step-telemetry.jsonl carries tokens_per_expert, expert_usage_entropy_bits, bank_switches_per_token, same_expert_rate, and per-layer router_confidence_distribution; run-log.json includes 21 eval_points at 1k-step cadence, final_grad_norms, and frozen_teacher_checkpoint_sha; all top-level artifacts carry canonical self-hashes and validate-artifacts.py reports ok.

summary: At HEAD 26e01079 the bd-3e10j closure claims remain supported. The only patches since the prior PASS at 09e157e are (1) d824b43 refreshing the Claude review record and (2) 26e0107 which corrects the report's H4 verdict from Confirmed to Refuted by deriving it from comparison.json.pareto_verdict (Dense-wins-under-byte-equivalence) rather than pinning Confirmed. This aligns the report with RFC §H4 falsification rules (Pareto refutation when dense wins on the (val_bpc, deployed_bytes_total) plane under matched bytes) and with the FailParity outcome that already refuted H3. emit-report.py now enforces this mapping (PARETO_H4_REFUTING set, hypothesis_status/h4_status_from_pareto helpers, falsification_summary), and scripts/tests/s7_emit_report_test.sh exercises both the H4-Confirmed (MoE-dominates) and H4-Refuted (Dense-wins-under-byte-equivalence) branches with the associated falsification-summary string. The refreshed report_self_hash (9a5c4b5...) validates cleanly: validate-report.py --root . and validate-artifacts.py --root . both report ok; scripts/tests/s7_emit_report_test.sh passes. The production-runner substrate itself (gbf-experiments/src/s7/production_runner.rs, 20,000-step Burn AdamW loop, Phase-A teacher freeze, per-step run/grad/router telemetry, matched-bytes scores across 10 seed×topology runs, seed-0 production_closure_retrain_score lambda_switch sweep, comparison/frontier/oracle/emulator support artifacts) is unchanged from the prior PASSed review and audit-production-runner.py still reports missing_code_surface_count=0, production_artifact_count=48, blocking_dependency_present=true. The remaining audit errors are the by-design guards that clear on bd-3e10j resolution. Bead-level review only; final bd-2v9r packet closure remains separate.
